Definition: a Chetsronite or (collectively) descendants of Chetsron
BiblicalUsage: The Hezronites are the descendants of Hezron, named in the census of Numbers as a family of Reuben and a family of Judah. They stand in the count of the tribes on the plains of Moab, two households sharing one ancestor's name.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God counts families by name, and the census is His way of saying every household belongs.
